data.long_meaning: The one that is desirable, precious, and valuable. Derived from the Arabic word 'mer' meaning 'desirable' and 'wa' meaning 'and', 'merwa' implies the idea of something valuable that is desired by many. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Merwa usually hope their child will grow to embody desirable, precious and live with faith, good character and purpose.

A child bearing such a name would be cherished and encouraged to embody the qualities suggested by its meaning.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Merwa lies in its association with the inherent worth and value assigned to all beings in Islamic beliefs. This notion is deeply rooted in Islamic teachings and serves as a reminder of the importance of treating all beings with respect, kindness, and compassion.
